description: Two assertion-only semantic probes for adaptive bed-mesh min expansion and zero-spacing floor; expected coordinates derive from the analytic first-layer island envelope, not emitted centerline extents.

mutants.test_filter: Adaptive bed mesh margins follow the analytic first-layer island envelope
mutants.description: Use the wrong min operation for the lower adaptive extent. The unarranged cube analytic island envelope is [0,0]-[12,8], so zero margin must preserve it and 2 mm margin must expand it by two millimeters.

mutants.test_filter: Adaptive bed mesh limits clip the analytic island envelope and zero probe spacing uses the minimum
mutants.description: Lower the per-axis effective-distance floor. With the analytic envelope, 100 mm expansion, and explicit [1,2]-[10,6] clipping, zero spacing must use the 1 mm floor, producing 10 x 5 points.
